liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, and with {{undrawn_facilities@FY2024}} of undrawn committed facilities liquidity stood at {{liquidity@FY2024}}, or {{liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}} of revenue.

Debt due within a year rose by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2024}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}}, covered {{short_term_debt_cover@FY2024}} by liquidity, and borrowings maturing within the following year of {{borrowings_due_2y@FY2024}} are covered {{liquidity_to_borrowings_due_2y@FY2024}} by liquidity, so near-term maturities are met without new funding.

Free cash flow after lease payments turned positive at {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, from {{fcf_after_leases@FY2023}} in FY2023, lifting FCF after leases to debt by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}}.

Customer prepayments rose, with contract liabilities up by {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2024}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2024}} and advance ticket cover at {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}}, so a larger share of the cash balance is customers' money.
